title: Polynomial-time choice of a greedy matching order guaranteeing22/43 against every arrival order
difficulty_reason: The authors introduce a rotation-stable maximal path cover of the spoiling digraph and a polynomial-time construction that partitions vertices into singleton, endpoint and alternating path classes. Four different priority orders are then analyzed through source-local spoiling exclusions and neighborhood-mass inequalities, including the cycle-closing endpoint case. The explicit weighted combination of these four guarantees and computable path/matching parameters yields the22/43 order against every arrival order; ordinary maximal-matching bounds and the supporting regular/Hamiltonian consequences are not extra units.
